RECOIL has no PCW decoder. MicroDesign 2 area, written by pbm2mda per Creative Technology's 1992 format sheet (John Elliott's mdaspec page): run-length stream ends exactly at EOF (48512 bytes); set bit = white; square pixels (the pictures look stretched when doubled). Reviewed by eye: the white-stroked hieroglyph cartouche and corner test patterns of the same test picture as the KiSS abydos cels, so the bit polarity (1 = white) matches the source. No second decoder was available (Deark 1.7.3 has no PCW module).
